Free All VRAM

You don't need this workflow for everyday use: with the node pack installed, the normal "Unload Models" and "Free model and node cache" buttons (and POST /free) already free everything.

Use it to see what is about to be stopped (the report on the right), or queue it between two heavy workflows to free memory exactly at that point of the queue.

When it finishes: all ComfyUI models are unloaded, the node cache is cleared, custom-node worker processes on the GPU are stopped (they restart on next use) and orphaned workers from a crashed ComfyUI are cleaned up. Models a custom node keeps for itself are listed in the console and at /free_all_vram/status.
